'''Balazausa''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who,<ref name="article" /> around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="date">''[[Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs]]'' occurs not long after the [[occupation of Bespin]] depicted in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the occupation occurs in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]</ref> was a high-level [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]] within the [[Bank of Aargau/Legends|Bank of Aargau]],<ref name="article" /> which was headquartered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]].<ref name="location">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030814aargau2|series=Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs|text=Part 2: Secure Lines of Credit}}</ref> Within the Bank's hierarchy, Balazausa held a title of [[Depositor]] [[Council (disambiguation)|Councilwoman]], but was also a covert contact of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Li-Suun Niik]], who ran a [[Li-Suun Niik's Criminal Organization|criminal empire]].<ref name="article" />

==Behind the scenes==
Balazausa was mentioned in the [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Wizards.com|website]] article [[Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs|''Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs, Part 3: Now 99% Crime Free'']] for their [[roleplaying game]], ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. The article was written by [[Cory J. Herndon]] and released in [[2003]]. The Depositor Councilwoman was only mentioned as a contact of Li-Suun Niik within his information and statistics.<ref name="article" />
